assistantEncodedEvidenceReview.merchandiseResult: Restored open star irises and thin gold round glasses remain visible after encoding, including S15 cup and S16 pouch. Original S08 physical leaf occlusion remains. Non-restored print softness remains.

wholeFrameSequence.method: Every encoded frame viewed in order through all 60 JPEG pages; separate native crops and five whole-frame contexts examined. No interpolated or AI enhanced inspection images.
wholeFrameSequence.observations: S01 left dorsal curtain pinch remains continuous. S05 pedals and background continue without the reported reset. S07 legs move from the start. S08 original leaf covers and uncovers the printed eye without animated blinking. S12 rowing/recovery, S13 attached umbrella grip and empty wet street, S14 wet shelter, S15 continuous lift then hold and S16 alternating visible legs and pouch sway remain continuous. All 15 scene joins stay on their original frame boundaries; no added real head, face or unrelated person observed.
wholeFrameSequence.limits: Downsampled whole-frame sequence is not every 4K pixel inspected separately or continuous human playback. S16 feet mostly remain outside the frame; full foot-ground contact cannot be certified.

assistantEncodedEvidenceReview.nativeContextResult: Original two-line title at f630. S15 f1620 cup rests on the counter and f1739 is held above it with the same two attached hands. S16 f1740 and final f1889 preserve the bag print and continuous rail/steps; no premature end fade.
assistantEncodedEvidenceReview.knownBoundary: Only the unchanged first 63 seconds, closingFadeSeconds=0; no S20/S48 or full 205-second film included.
